Optional analysis_units.tsv ULTIMA_SUBSAMPLE_PCT values strictly inside (0,1) deterministically downsample the selected input CRAM with fixed samtools seed 33; an activating value with FASTQ input fails before DAG construction, and every other value runs full depth.

result_export.description: DayOA runs pipeline work only. After the controller exits successfully, DYEC must separately record an export visit with explicit intent, create a no-delete DRA export from the analysis root, and verify the detached receipt and expected S3 objects.
result_export.manual_visit_command:
dyec analysis visit \
  --analysis-root "$ANALYSIS_ROOT" \
  --mode export \
  --intent "export completed pipeline results to $DESTINATION_S3_URI without FSx cleanup" \
  --s3-visit-uri "$DESTINATION_S3_URI"
post_controller_protocol: DYEC must wait for a successful controller exit before export.
DYEC must run dyec analysis visit with --mode export and explicit --intent before dyec export.
DYEC must run dyec export from the analysis root, not the nested DayOA checkout.
success_checks: The workflow controller exited successfully before export began.
The expected pipeline result objects, including final reports, are present at the exact destination S3 prefix.
